summary: Run `awx-manage gather_analytics --ship` to send analytics outside the default 4-hour window, and `awx-manage host_metric --since YYYY-MM-DD --json` to count unique automated hosts in disconnected environments.
questions: How do I gather analytics on demand?
How do I count unique hosts automated offline?

answer_card.title: Analytics and host metrics on demand
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
awx-manage gather_analytics --ship                 # send now (default window 4h)
awx-manage host_metric --since 2025-01-01 --json   # unique hosts, disconnected envs
```
`--since` and `--json` are optional.
